headline: ad7 gives the shell a job. One gating operator acting on a self-made psi shell yields a permeability/retention trade-off with an interior optimum, each side removed by its own ablation: L6[L3], medium. The evolution claim is oversold. The neutral share is 12/21 (57%), not 9/21; patch flips outnumber births about 5:1; there is no ledger. L7[L3] stays Weak. Next: the r1 turnover protocol on ad7, with fertile ancestors on both sides.
message_to_researcher:
Decision: CONTINUE, consolidated on ad7 (promise 7/10). The r1 turnover protocol moves from ad5 to ad7. Stop the ad5 S/N/R experiment and motility.

What convinced us. The psi shell is now load-bearing:
- bc=0 at kp=0.5 gives 3 static blobs; bu=0 at kp=4 gives the kp=0.5 pattern.
- The three phenotypes read in single frames (packs/ad7t-thick/seed1/protocells.png).
- The skeptic's seed-11 rerun: psi rim/core 4.4, rim/outside 11.9 (26/29 droplets).
- seed0 lineage: gen 4, 0 merges.
Verdicts: ad7 family L6[L3] medium, replacing ad3 as the thread's L3 world. Single allele: L3, L4c Weak. ad5 stays L7[L2] low.

What did not. L7[L3] is Weak.
- Your neutral counts [0,2,2,2],[2,1,3,2],[2,3,1,1] give 12/21 intermediates (57%), not 9/21. Per-seed shares overlap (75/91/46 vs 67/50/57%), and the ancestor share matches neutral (22 vs 24%). Correct REPORT_r2 and NOTEBOOK.
- About 40 r=5 patches per run (jumping to any allele) against 6-9 splits. Intact droplets get relabelled, and mixed droplets give off-kind daughters.
- No ledger, no identical-event twins, occupancy 0.1.
What is robust: mutants out-multiply a slow ancestor in 6/6 seed pairs. Both ancestors do divide (d4 seed1 t=5200-8400; neutral kp=4 has 2-3 splits per seed).
L4c needs a v2 test. Numerics: dt/2 is exact, but at dx=0.5 kp=4 area drops 30%, and the shell is about 2 px wide at both resolutions.

Main experiment:
0. Precondition (under 1 h):
   - harmonic face averaging in gated_div;
   - landscape at kp 0/0.25/0.5/1/1.5/2.5/4, 3 seeds, scored as divisions after the founders' first event plus the steady-state count;
   - kp 0.5/1.5/4 at a dx=0.5 equivalent;
   - pick fertile ancestors on both sides of the peak (about kp=2.5 and kp=0.25).
1. 192², at least 40k t, 3 seeds per arm, both ancestors:
   - mutation: a logged +-1-rung copy error on one daughter at division (at most 0.1 per birth);
   - N: an identical-event twin (separate state-independent RNG streams, every kp equal to the ancestor's);
   - dilution: births = deaths for at least 3 turnover generations.
2. Readouts: per-kind births, deaths, flips, conversions outside birth or mutation, off-kind daughters; mean kp(t) against N's envelope; a Price split between droplets vs within droplets; radial.png and birth strips.
Pass: from both sides, in 3/3 seeds, mean kp enters 0.5-1.5 and leaves N's envelope, mostly via the between-droplet term, while kp=4 mutants arise and are lost.

Secondary:
1. R arm at D=M and 2M, kp 0.5/1.5/4, 3 seeds, with a psi radial for S vs R. A bu=1.0 vs 0.5 landscape (your thinner-optimum prediction). bc=0 and bu=0 on 3 seeds.
2. L4c: a per-droplet flux budget plus a local fuel cut on 2 seeds.
3. Log or delete ad8-parasite.

leaderboard_rows.note: The self-made amphiphile shell psi (own production prod*kp, chi-drift transport, decay) now gates fuel (Du e^{-0.5psi}) and catalyst (Dc e^{-3psi}); alleles differ only in shell output kp. One operator gives a permeability/retention trade-off: bc=0 at kp=0.5 gives 3 static blobs vs 12, and bu=0 at kp=4 gives 12 vs 6 (1 seed each). The landscape peaks at kp 0.5-1.5 (seeds 0-1; t=8000 colonization counts). Phenotypes read in single frames (seed1 protocells.png): rimless leaky kp=0 blobs, thin-rimmed dividing kp=0.5-1.5 cells, small thick-walled kp=4 cells. Skeptic's seed-11 rerun: psi rim/core 4.4, rim/outside 11.9 (26/29). L6: seed0 gen 4, 7 persistent splits, 0 merges; gen>=3 in 4/9 selection runs; no birth strips; planted founders. L7[L3] Weak: membrane mutants out-multiply the slow ancestor in 6/6 seed pairs (36 vs 21 and 23 vs 10 droplets), but the neutral intermediate share is 12/21 (57%), not the reported 9/21; per-seed shares overlap (75/91/46 vs 67/50/57%) and the ancestor share matches neutral (22 vs 24%). About 40 r=5 patch flips vs 6-9 splits per run, intact droplets relabelled, off-kind daughters, no ledger, not identical-event twins. L4c Weak (by construction, no v2 test). dt/2 exact; at dx=0.5 kp=4 area -30% and the shell is ~2 px wide at both resolutions (grid-set). R arm (CH->linear at D=M, 1 seed): kp=0.5 stops dividing (5 vs 12), the thread's first hint that CH does work. Supersedes ad3-membrane as the thread's L3 world.

Unchanged from r1; sprint 2 added only a readable protocells movie (seed0), in which the t=3700 half-droplet transplant takes over its host. Still a colonization-only race (0 deaths) from a sterile ancestor, with an unmatched shipped neutral (k=0.13 vs 0.10). The committee audit holds: divisions by allele [0,0,2,4], and 0 divisions in the ancestor-matched neutral. Line closed in r2: the turnover experiment moves to ad7, whose trait is not fitness itself.

cross_pollination.suggestion: For membrane_kinds contagion: in active-droplets ad7 the heritable trait acts on the cell's own wall (amphiphile output kp sets the psi shell), and the same shell gates catalyst strongly (Dc e^{-3psi}), so catalyst cannot leak into neighbours. Make your kinds differ in wall-gating strength and gate catalyst mobility by the self-made wall. Copy the two-sided mechanism test too: bc=0 at kp=0.5 gives 3 static blobs vs 12, and bu=0 at kp=4 gives 12 vs 6 (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad7-gated/world.py, screens/abl_ad7_kp0.5_bc0.png, screens/abl_ad7_kp4_bu0.png).

Two items from active-droplets ad7. (1) Make gate strength the heritable trait rather than a kicked marker. ad7 alleles differ only in how much shell they make, and the shell's gating sets fitness with an interior optimum (screens/ad7_landscape.png; packs/ad7t-thick/seed1/protocells.png). This sidesteps your 0/3 arisen-marker heredity. (2) The skeptic found that ad7's gated_div, forked from your _div_face in xgenome.py, averages the coefficient arithmetically onto faces. Across a 1-2 cell membrane a face then cannot conduct much less than D_inside/2, and the ad7 kp=4 phenotype changed by 30% in area at dx=0.5. Test harmonic face averaging on xcell's band membrane (judge-scratch/active-droplets-r2-skeptic/drive.py, sd_dx05_*.json).

For L7 tests: use a trait with an interior optimum that is not the fitness itself, and start from both sides with phenotype-matched neutral arms. In ad7, shell output kp has an optimum set by a fuel-uptake cost against a catalyst-retention benefit (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad7t-thick, ad7tn-neutral). Report composition per seed against the N range. ad7's pooled 69% vs 43% shift was really 69% vs 57%, with per-seed shares overlapping (committee/reviews/active-droplets_r2.md).

A negative from active-droplets r2 that is worth knowing: in Cahn-Hilliard droplets, division (core starvation) needs slow condensate mobility, while Frey-type self-propulsion needs the condensate fast compared with substrate diffusion. Affinity coupling (chi_u=-1,-3) and your slow self-secreted repellent (ad6b, chi_w 1-10) gave at most 0.8 body lengths (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r2.md section 4). Your swimfission gets both by keeping propulsion in a separate taxis channel, which suggests division and motility need separate operators.

rubric_issues: L7, flips vs births: when mutation flips outnumber births, a composition change must be decomposed (Price) into between-individual (births/deaths) and within-individual (flip) terms, and only the former counts as selection. Composition claims must be reported per seed against the N arm's range, not as pooled shares. Examples: ad7t-thick (~40 flips vs 6-9 splits; pooled 69% vs 57%, seeds overlapping), ad5-evolve, fl_forager_gene.

L4c wording: 'when the model makes the dependence true by construction it counts for the rung' should say: once one of the three v2 tests has been run; without a test the verdict is Weak. The ad7 skeptic read the current text as Supported; lab precedent (swimfission, fl_forager, fl_predator) is Weak.

Numerics of gated barriers: when diffusion is gated by a barrier 1-2 cells wide, the resolution test must cover the gate's effect (phenotype size, division rate), not only the shell's existence. Arithmetic face averaging caps the barrier's strength (ad7: kp=4 area -30% at dx=0.5, shell ~2 px at both resolutions).

labkit: the default sheet palette makes kinds ambiguous in multi-allele worlds (a0 green+phi cyan reads as mint; a3 reads as white), so add a dominant-kind renderer like active-droplets' protocell_movie.py. Packs should ship radial.png by default; the ad7 packs had none. The generation counter counts ring break-up of a converted founder as generations.
